locator: Results P9 and P12
printed_value: Healthy controls (n = 458) form one category; cancers are stratified by ichorCNA tumour fraction into [0, 0.03] (n = 736), (0.03, 0.1] (n = 239), (0.1, 0.2] (n = 121) and (0.2, 1] (n = 136). Models are trained and tested within each category; the [0, 0.03] category has 861 training samples (325 healthy, 536 cancer).
